title: "I thought we were done with this."
summary: Donald Trump is messing with the map again — this time renaming Lake Ontario, in a perhaps misguided attempt to seize the upper hand in a trade war with Canada that he is pursuing for no discernible reason. Jessica Tarlov and Aaron Parnas discuss the implications, on Raging Perspective.
